extraction.Name: Enoch H. Raymond, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded August 9, 1920, by McCullough & Murphy
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to F. Lewis McCullough for $2000 on August 9, 1920; conveyed by deed to Charles E. Pelletier for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, subject to the mortgage, on January 31, 1921
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 759700 issued; Northwest quarter section 27, township 96, north of range 77; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee April 3, 1920; Raymond and his wife were parties to both the mortgage and the deed conveyance
